authority.allowed_scope: independent synthetic contributor proposal and mock-only engineering

question: Does learner-chosen intervention plus cold-restorable bounded memory generalize from a one-mediator causal chain to an unfamiliar two-mediator fork, outperforming fitted active Bayesian and contextual-bandit controls under matched decision horizons and public information?
prior_negative: KNOW40 fixed forced-action observations, x=c XOR (a<<1), eight-cell complete support, and 0/12 strong-control intervention wins per held family; source audit PR #1327 issuecomment-7053773479.
primary_falsification: In both causal families, action-0 observational data are exactly independent of hidden theta, but action-1 consequences identify theta in contrastive contexts; a passive learner cannot recover theta from action-0 observations alone, even with infinite samples.

structural_equations.public_context: c=t mod 8, 3 binary features c0=c&1, c1=(c>>1)&1, c2=(c>>2)&1
structural_equations.public_action: a in {0,1} chosen by each learner before seeing the next outcome; a is NOT fixed by evaluator
structural_equations.public_key: k=c+8*a yields sixteen distinct (context,action) inputs, never c XOR (a<<1)
structural_equations.hidden_theta: theta in {0,1} known only to evaluator
structural_equations.fit_chain: m=a AND (c0 XOR theta); q=0.35+0.40*m-0.20*a; c1,c2 are observed distractors
structural_equations.held_fork: m1=a AND (c0 XOR theta); m2=a AND (c1 XOR c2 XOR theta); q=0.35+0.20*m1+0.20*m2-0.20*a
structural_equations.graph_change: CHAIN has one action-mediated path; FORK has two, one involving a new c1/c2 interaction. Held fork is not one of the fit laws.
structural_equations.reward: binary y sampled with SHA256-based independent uniform coin; net expected utility q-0.05*a; evaluate realized utility as y-0.05*a
structural_equations.phases: A chain theta0 t=0..63; B fork theta_b t=64..127; A chain theta0 t=128..191; B same fork theta_b t=192..255
structural_equations.sham: Separate A-only branch (chain theta0 all steps), not scored as new native training
structural_equations.secret: Graph identity, theta, q, future Bernoulli coin and alternate-action outcome never passed to learner; c,a,y,previous reward,step index only
structural_equations.counterfactual: Evaluator may calculate expected q(c,0),q(c,1) for regret scoring but MUST NOT open or feed unchosen sampled outcomes

seed_custody.historical_overlap: New synthetic source family and seed set distinct from KNOW29-40, never protected original CausalGym episodes
seed_custody.primary_first_use: NONE; held source generation forbidden in mock-only tests; explicit separately qualified one-shot after prospective source+protocol freeze and full exact-head dual-OS final regression

participants.candidate: Proposed bounded, tokenless context-action local memory and contradiction-gated active choice; implementation/code/blob MUST be pinned before any held opening; use no KNOW40 oracle metadata.
participants.fitted_bayesian: Fit-only calibrated Bayesian active planner marginalizing hidden theta and graph uncertainty over explicitly pinned CHAIN/FORK hypotheses; include exploration value and cost; never reveal actual held graph.
participants.bandit: Fully trained conventional contextual Bernoulli bandit with 16 context-action Beta counts and a frozen exploration rule selected only on FIT.
participants.lookup: 16-cell online Beta lookup with FIT-selected exploration and identical action horizons.
participants.passive: Always choose a0, observes only y for a0; intentionally information-limited negative control.
participants.random: Deterministic pseudorandom per-step action, independent of hidden labels, matched decision horizon.
participants.no_memory: Ablate persistent read/write memory while retaining same observations and action opportunities.
participants.oracle: Evaluator-only optimal expected utility, not an eligible trained competitor.

budgets.same_step_budget: 256 decisions and one actually experienced consequence per arm per world; arms choose different actions, so realized evidence can differ by design; report this explicitly

scoring.primary: Mean per-world expected net-utility regret in B_second t192..255, lower better, per family of 12; before observing y
secondary: A_return expected regret and old-task function retention
realized net utility with confidence intervals
active a1 rate and total action count
time per update and checkpoint bytes
A-only sham false B memory writes
active vs passive theta identification on counterfactual-held contexts

acceptance.P0: Exactly 12 fit+24 held, no seed reuse, at most 3072 fit actions and exactly 6144 held actual actions per arm, no unchosen outcome reveals or metadata leakage, exact cold restore and source provenance.
acceptance.P1: For all contexts and graph/parameter values q(a0)=0.35; both theta values yield different q(a1) in >=4/8 fork contexts; key(c,a) covers 16 distinct entries.
acceptance.H1: Candidate second-B mean expected net regret <= BOTH fit-selected active Bayesian and strongest contextual bandit by at least 0.02 in each held theta family AND >=9/12 paired wins against per-world best strong control per family.
acceptance.H2: Candidate returning-A regret <= fit-selected Bayesian +0.02 in each family, no previously learned A probability readout changes immediately after cold restoration, and never loses original A bank capacity.
acceptance.H3: Candidate improves second-B regret over passive, random and no-memory controls by >=0.05 in each family; record intervention count and realized reward separately.
acceptance.H4: Every candidate cold restore reproduces exact checkpoints, pre-update decision probabilities and next action for matched future public input; state size <=4096 bytes.
acceptance.verdict: DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED only if P0,P1,H1,H2,H3,H4 all pass; otherwise DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO or INVALID for protocol/custody leakage. Never SCIENTIFIC_PASS from synthetic results alone.

qualification: First publish this prereg at an immutable SHA. Then implement candidate+strong controls, mock-only design tests (no private coin use), focused tests and negative controls, mandatory full final dual-OS regression on the exact candidate tree, independently admitted one-shot held use, audit immutable scores. No result-based changes to this protocol.
stops: No automatic trial from a prereg-only commit; no protected-world use or new owner command; no post-result tuning/replay/threshold changes, preserve failures.
